items.meta_title: Quick Launch: Connect From the Notification Bar | VpnHood!
items.meta_description: Quick Launch adds a tile to the Android quick settings panel so you can connect to the VPN in a single tap. Available in VpnHood!
items.title: Quick Launch
items.lead: Connect to the VPN instantly from the notification bar with a single tap.
items.shot_alt: The Quick Launch screen in the VpnHood! app
items.platforms: Android only. Quick settings tiles are an Android feature.
items.how_desc: Adds a VpnHood! tile to the Android quick settings panel, so connecting takes one tap from any screen without opening the app.
items.when_desc: If you connect and disconnect through the day rather than staying on all the time.
items.cost_desc: Nothing. It is a shortcut, not a change to how the VPN works.
